name: Zone of proximal development (Vygotsky)
apa7_reference: Beach, R., Appleman, D., Simon, R., & Fecho, B. (2026). *Teaching literature to adolescents* (5th ed.). Routledge.
in_text: (Vygotsky, 1978, as cited in Beach et al., 2026, p. 41)
use_when: Students work on tasks just beyond what they can do alone, with support from the teacher or peers.
connection_template: Students work on {task} with support from {teacher or peers}, which targets the gap between what they can do alone and what they can do with help (Vygotsky, 1978, as cited in Beach et al., 2026, p. 41).

name: Gradual release of responsibility (Pearson & Gallagher)
apa7_reference: Pearson, P. D., & Gallagher, M. C. (1983). The instruction of reading comprehension. *Contemporary Educational Psychology, 8*(3), 317–344. https://doi.org/10.1016/0361-476X(83)90019-X
use_when: The lesson moves from teacher modeling to guided practice to independent practice.
connection_template: Students move from {modeled} to {guided} to {independent}, following the gradual release model (Pearson & Gallagher, 1983).

name: Revised Bloom's taxonomy (Anderson & Krathwohl)
apa7_reference: Krathwohl, D. R. (2002). A revision of Bloom's taxonomy: An overview. *Theory Into Practice, 41*(4), 212-218. https://doi.org/10.1207/s15430421tip4104_2

connection_template: The objective uses the verb "{verb}", which sits at the {level} level of the revised Bloom's taxonomy and asks students to work with {knowledge type} knowledge (Krathwohl, 2002).

name: Scaffolding (Wood, Bruner & Ross)
apa7_reference: Wood, D., Bruner, J. S., & Ross, G. (1976). The role of tutoring in problem solving. *Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry, 17*(2), 89–100. https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1469-7610.1976.tb00381.x
use_when: The teacher provides temporary supports (models, sentence frames, organizers) that are removed as students gain skill.
connection_template: The teacher provides {support} for {task} and removes it as students become more independent, a form of scaffolding (Wood et al., 1976).

name: Differentiated instruction (Tomlinson)
apa7_reference: Tomlinson, C. A. (2014). *The differentiated classroom: Responding to the needs of all learners* (2nd ed.). ASCD.

name: Self-efficacy (Bandura)
apa7_reference: Bandura, A. (1977). Self-efficacy: Toward a unifying theory of behavioral change. *Psychological Review, 84*(2), 191–215. https://doi.org/10.1037/0033-295X.84.2.191
use_when: The lesson builds student confidence through achievable tasks, success experiences, and modeling.
connection_template: Students begin with {accessible task} so they experience early success and build confidence for {harder task} (Bandura, 1977).
